Equipment.Presenting: Desktop computer running the jsPsych experiment in a browser (exact machine/OS/browser version not reported)
Equipment.Monitor: 23.8-inch monitor, 1080 x 768, 60 Hz (as reported in the manuscript; the raw exports show a full-screen canvas width of 1920 px, which is consistent with an 8 deg aperture at 300 px and a 0.15 deg dot diameter at 60 cm viewing distance - see detail)

Physical_Environment.Viewing_distance: 60 cm (chin rest; as reported in the manuscript)

Experimental_Design.Conditions: Matching task: 16 within-subject conditions (2 association: self vs other x 2 matchness: matching vs nonmatching x 4 difficulty levels: very easy/easy/difficult/very difficult); choice task: 8 within-subject conditions (2 association x 4 difficulty). Between-subjects factor: perceptual dimension of the RDK task (motion vs colour)

Block_Structure.Block_number: Matching task: 8 blocks of 48 trials; choice task: 4 blocks of 48 trials (rest-delimited); adaptive staircase: 8 groups of 12 trials
Block_Structure.Trial_number: 384 trials in the matching task (24 per condition) and 192 trials in the choice task (24 per condition) per participant; staircase 96 trials; practice 32 trials per round (matching) and 16 trials per round (choice)
Block_Structure.Practice_trials: 32 trials per round in the matching task and 16 trials per round in the choice task; rounds repeat until >=65% correct (1-17 rounds observed; practice trial counts therefore vary between participants)

Trial_Structure.Fixation_duration: 500 ms (white '+' in 48 px font on a black background)
Trial_Structure.SOA: 0 ms (the dot field and the identity label are presented simultaneously within the same trial; the label appears below the dot field)
Trial_Structure.ISI: Approximately 0 ms (the stimulus starts immediately after the 500 ms fixation trial; not reported separately in the manuscript)
Trial_Structure.Response_deadline: 3000 ms (raw trial_duration, identical for all trials; not stated in the manuscript)
Trial_Structure.ITI: 300-1000 ms random (jsPsych default_iti), followed by the 500 ms fixation cross that opens the next trial
Trial_Structure.Feedback_duration: 500 ms (practice phase only: correct / incorrect / too fast (< 250 ms) / too slow (no response))

Stimulus_Properties.Fixation: White '+' (48 px font) on a black background, 500 ms
Stimulus_Properties.Shape: Random-dot kinematogram (RDK): 100 dots, dot diameter 0.15 deg, moving within an invisible 8 deg diameter aperture at 3 deg/s, unlimited dot life. The identity-bearing stimulus layer is the RDK feature that was associated with an identity - motion direction (left/right, raw coherent_direction 180/0) in the motion group, dominant colour (blue/red) in the colour group - and not a geometric shape
Stimulus_Properties.Label: Identity label presented as an image: 我 (self) or 他 / 她 (other, matching the participant's gender), 230 x 220 px, below the dot field. Presented in the matching task only; in the choice task the label column carries the identity the feature is associated with (not presented on screen)

Colors.Stimulus: Dots: red hsl(0, 50%, 50%) and blue hsl(225, 50%, 50%); in the colour task one colour was the target (more numerous) and in the motion task the two colours were equally frequent. Note: the manuscript text labels the two HSL values in the opposite order; the raw dot_color values are authoritative

exp1.detail: Experiment 1 of Wu & Hu (2026, ChinaXiv preprint 202606.00118, DOI 10.12074/202606.00118). Pre-registration: AsPredicted #246,312 (2025-09-09, https://aspredicted.org/rmsm-tzcz.pdf). Data source: the authors' GitHub repository https://github.com/Wsy122/SPE_Rand_Dots (SPE_analysis/3_Data/exp1/RawData/{motion,color}/exp1_subj_<N>.csv, one jsPsych wide CSV per participant; N = 1-70 motion group, 71-141 colour group). Imported with 1_Data/Wu_2026_Chinaxiv/Wu_2026_Chinaxiv_clean.R. SESSION/PHASE: every participant completed, in one session, (1) an adaptive staircase threshold estimation (part motion_test or color_test, 96 trials in 8 groups of 12, run BEFORE the association instructions - no association, difficulty, label or matching information exists for these trials, hence NA in the corresponding columns); (2) matching-task practice rounds (>=65% correct criterion, repeated; block boundaries delimited by instruction rows); (3) the formal matching task (part match_RDK, 8 blocks x 48 trials); (4) choice-task practice rounds (16 trials per round); (5) the formal choice task (part RDK, 4 blocks x 48 trials). Phase is recorded in the Phase column (staircase/practice/main) and Block is numbered sequentially within a participant across tasks and phases; Trial is the within-block index. QUESTIONNAIRE ROWS (not trials, therefore not in the Clean file): part=survey (demographics: sex, age, handedness, self-reported colour blindness), the first part=color_test row (trial_type=survey-text, colour-blindness picture screening, answer e.g. BE) and part=survey_isMatch (post-task manipulation check of the learned binding) were moved to Wu_2026_Chinaxiv_Exp1_subj_info.csv (Color_Blindness_SelfReport, ColorTest_Answer, Manip_Check_Self / Manip_Check_Other) as agreed on 2026-10-06. BINDING: the feature-identity mapping was counterbalanced across participants and is recoverable per participant from the formal matching trials (Self_Feature in subj_info); motion trials: coherent_direction 0 = right / 180 = left, verified by the response-accuracy pattern of the choice task (0 -> arrowright correct, 180 -> arrowleft correct); colour trials: the first element of dot_color_final is the target (more numerous) colour, verified by the response-accuracy pattern (hsl(0) target -> key d correct, hsl(225) target -> key k correct). Response keys: f/j in the matching task (mapping counterbalanced across participants), arrowleft/arrowright for motion discrimination, d/k for colour discrimination. ACC: 1 = correct, 0 = incorrect, NA = no response (raw rt = -1 with an empty response field; the raw correct flag is 'false' for these trials and was NOT coded as an error). No trial filtering was applied (all 109,040 task trials of the 141 participants are retained; staircase 13,536 + practice 14,288 + formal 81,216). ISSUE 1 (registered): the authors' shared cleaned file 3_Data/exp1/CleanData/data_color.csv additionally contains the motion-group participant Subject 70 (563 rows, row-identical to data_motion.csv on the shared columns) because the author's script filters subj_idx %in% seq(70, 141), one index wider than its own group definition (71-141); the author's colour-group statistics therefore include 72 participants. This database file is not affected (it was rebuilt from the raw exports). The remaining author files (data_motion.csv, data_color.csv) reproduce the raw formal segments exactly (per-participant row counts 70/70 and 71/71 identical; row-level values identical on spot checks, RT window 100-3000 ms per the pre-registration and manuscript), which was used as a cross-check. ISSUE 3 (registered): the manuscript's Exp1 sentence '48 trials per condition, 384 in total' is a wording slip - the design is 16 conditions x 24 trials (384 = 8 blocks x 48), as in the raw data. ISSUE 6 (registered): the manuscript reports a 23.8-inch monitor with 1080 x 768 resolution; the raw exports show a full-screen canvas width of 1920 px, and the reported physical values (8 deg aperture = 300 px, 0.15 deg dot diameter = 6 px at 60 cm viewing distance for a 23.8-inch 16:9 screen) are self-consistent only for a 1920 px wide display (1080 px would imply 13.2 deg and 0.263 deg). The field values follow the manuscript; the discrepancy is recorded here. ISSUE 8 (registered): the manuscript's parenthetical HSL labels for red and blue are swapped relative to the raw dot_color values (hsl(225) = blue, hsl(0) = red). Stimulus physical sizes were specified in pixels in the program (aperture 300 px, dot radius 3 px, canvas height 420 px); the virtual-chin rest calibration procedure is present in the program but commented out of the final timeline, consistent with the laboratory setting using a physical chin rest. Stimulus_order is recorded as Simultaneous for the experiment (the dot field and the identity label are presented together in the matching task); the choice task presents the dot field only, without a label. CROSS-CHECK after ingestion: recomputing descriptive association effects from this database file (per-participant geometric mean RT differences, other minus self, RT window 100-3000 ms as in the pre-registration) gives matching-task effects of +96.3 ms (motion) and +101.3 ms (colour) on correct trials and +80.4 / +85.3 ms when all trials with a response in the window are used, versus the manuscript's model-based estimates of +79.49 / +80.13 ms; the nonmatching effects (+18.4 ms motion, -89.9 ms colour) closely match the manuscript (+16.52 / -79.86 ms), and the choice task shows association effects of +10.9 ms (motion) and -2.5 ms (colour), consistent with the manuscript's near-zero coefficient. The remaining difference on the matching condition is expected because the manuscript reports posterior means of a Bayesian lognormal mixed model rather than raw mean differences.
